test_title: PYST 14 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

A. We need to B. discuss about the C. new marketing strategy D. in the next meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary error in the sentence lies in the use of the preposition "**about**" immediately following the verb "**discuss**."
 
• The verb "discuss" is transitive, meaning it requires a direct object to receive the action. It inherently means "to talk about."
 
• Adding "about" creates a redundancy (essentially saying "talk about about"). The preposition should simply be removed.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the segment **discuss about the**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We need to **discuss the** new marketing strategy in the next meeting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **We need to** – This segment is grammatically correct. It correctly pairs the subject "We" with the verb "need" and the infinitive marker "to."
 
• **new marketing strategy** – This segment is correct. It properly functions as the direct object noun phrase for the verb "discuss."
 
• **in the next meeting** – This segment is correct. It uses the appropriate prepositional phrase to establish where and when the discussion will take place.
